name: Joybound People & Pets - Pet Safety Net
description: Help to prevent pet surrender including vet care, food, rental deposits, boarding, and supplies
fullDescription: Joybound's Pet Safety Net helps qualifying Contra Costa County residents with critical resources to keep their pets at home and out of shelters.
whatTheyOffer:
- Veterinary treatment with good prognosis, spay/neuter, vaccines, and microchips
- Pet food, cat litter, and pet supplies
- Pet rental deposits and shelter impound fees
- Temporary boarding
- Behavior and training help
- Medical grooming and yard or fence repairs
howToGetIt:
1. Must be a Contra Costa County resident who meets program qualifications
2. Contact Joybound's Resource Center at 925-256-1273 ext. 450
3. Staff will assess needs and available resources
4. Receive assistance based on availability and need
keywords: Joybound, Pet Safety Net, emergency pet help, vet assistance, pet rental deposit, boarding, pet supplies, crisis, Contra Costa, prevent surrender
